metadata.creator: MTV Networks
metadata.description:
The Ren & Stimpy Show: The First and Second Season (Uncut) is a Ren & Stimpy DVD box set that contains 33 episodes from Season 1 and Season 2.

"Uncut" is not the most accurate description, however "Sven Hoek", "Powdered Toast Man", "Dog Show" and "Big House Blues" contain additional footage that was not aired originally on Nickelodeon or MTV. The episodes are "Digitally Remastered" from the Spike TV reruns, and so there are certain episodes that are electronically sped up (Stimpy's Fan Club), commercial fades in unexpected places, time cuts, "freezes", and DVNR (digital video noise reduction). It should be noted that some episodes (Big Baby Scam, Haunted House, Ren's Toothache, Out West, The Cat That Laid the Golden Hairball, Son of Stimpy) do have a few scenes missing.

Another major error is that the description says the episodes are in airing order, but they aren’t. For example, “In The Army/Powdered Toast Man” are the first two season two episodes in airing order, but the first two season two episodes on the DVD are “Ren’s Toothache/Rubber Nipple Salesman.”
